strings.zh: 西边浅葱市的码头翻新{NEWLINE}再过不久就能完工。{CLEAR}等完工之后就可以从那里{CLEAR}坐船去水都群岛或者枯叶市了。
strings.en: The renovation of the harbor in Olivine{NEWLINE}City to the west will be finished soon.{SCROLL}Once it’s done, you’ll be able to{NEWLINE}take a ship from there to the Alto{CLEAR}Mare Islands or Vermilion City.

strings.zh: 你去过水都群岛了吗？{NEWLINE}那里的涨潮季已经过去了,{CLEAR}现在去水都群岛的话{CLEAR}可以一览全部七个岛的大好风光。
strings.en: Have you been to the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Islands? High-tide season is over now.{SCROLL}If you go now, you can take in the{NEWLINE}grand views of all seven islands.

strings.zh: 我的硬币被那只黑暗鸦给抢走了,{NEWLINE}我想去要回来结果它就啄我。{CLEAR}吓得我只能躲在栅栏后面。{CLEAR}哥哥你应该是很厉害的训练家吧,{CLEAR}你能帮我把硬币拿回来吗？
strings.en: That Murkrow snatched my coin! I{NEWLINE}tried to get it back, but it pecked me.{SCROLL}I got so scared I’m{NEWLINE}hiding behind the fence.{SCROLL}Big brother, you must be{NEWLINE}a really strong Trainer. Can{CLEAR}you get my coin back for me?

strings.zh: 好,我帮你拿回来
strings.en: OK, I’ll get it back

strings.zh: 你自己想办法吧
strings.en: Figure it out yourself

strings.zh: 谢谢哥哥愿意帮忙。{NEWLINE}那只黑暗鸦很狡猾的,你要小心啊。
strings.en: Thanks for helping, big brother. That{NEWLINE}Murkrow is really sly, so be careful.

strings.zh: 谢谢姐姐愿意帮忙。{NEWLINE}那只黑暗鸦很狡猾的,你要小心啊。
strings.en: Thanks for helping, big sister. That{NEWLINE}Murkrow is really sly, so be careful.

strings.zh: 我的硬币被那只黑暗鸦给抢走了,{NEWLINE}我想去要回来结果它就啄我。{CLEAR}吓得我只能躲在栅栏后面。{CLEAR}姐姐你应该是很厉害的训练家吧,{CLEAR}你能帮我把硬币拿回来吗？
strings.en: That Murkrow snatched my coin! I{NEWLINE}tried to get it back, but it pecked me.{SCROLL}I got so scared I’m{NEWLINE}hiding behind the fence.{SCROLL}Big sister, you must be{NEWLINE}a really strong Trainer. Can{CLEAR}you get my coin back for me?

strings.zh: 哥哥已经拿回硬币了吗？
strings.en: Did you get my coin back, big brother?

strings.zh: 姐姐已经拿回硬币了吗？
strings.en: Did you get my coin back, big sister?

strings.zh: 其实这个硬币其实是我朋友{NEWLINE}送给我的生日礼物。{CLEAR}我那个朋友已经搬到很远的地方去了,{CLEAR}不知道以后还能不能再见到他。{CLEAR}所以我也就特别重视{CLEAR}他送我的这枚硬币。
strings.en: That coin was actually a{NEWLINE}birthday present from my friend.{SCROLL}He moved somewhere really far away, and{NEWLINE}I don’t know if I’ll ever see him again.{SCROLL}That’s why the coin he gave{NEWLINE}me means so much to me.

strings.zh: 哇！真的是我的硬币！{SCROLL}谢谢哥哥帮我拿回来,{NEWLINE}这是我平时爱吃的零食,{CLEAR}送给哥哥一些吧。
strings.en: Wow! It really is my coin!{SCROLL}Thanks for getting it back,{NEWLINE}big brother. These are my{CLEAR}favorite snacks. Have some!

strings.zh: 我看黑暗鸦已经走了,{NEWLINE}还以为硬币已经拿回来了呢。
strings.en: I saw the Murkrow leave, so I{NEWLINE}thought you’d gotten the coin back.

strings.zh: 可是哥哥的身上并没有硬币啊……
strings.en: But you don’t have the{NEWLINE}coin on you, big brother...

strings.zh: 可是姐姐的身上并没有硬币啊……
strings.en: But you don’t have the{NEWLINE}coin on you, big sister...

strings.zh: 这里是３８号道路{NEWLINE}南　浅葱市
strings.en: Rt. 38{NEWLINE}South to Olivine City

strings.zh: 贴心的告示牌！{SCROLL}精灵即将进化时,{NEWLINE}按下Ｂ键{CLEAR}精灵就会停止进化。{CLEAR}这被称为取消进化。
strings.en: Trainer Tips{SCROLL}When a Pokémon is about to evolve,{NEWLINE}press the B Button and it will{CLEAR}stop evolving.{SCROLL}This is called canceling evolution.
strings.notes: US Trainer Tips kept; zh says the same (press B to cancel evolution). | RV041: meaning: US line added 'startles the Pokémon' and dropped 'called canceling evolution'; retranslated from zh

strings.zh: 哇！真的是我的硬币！{SCROLL}谢谢姐姐帮我拿回来,{NEWLINE}这是我平时爱吃的零食,{CLEAR}送给姐姐一些吧。
strings.en: Wow! It really is my coin!{SCROLL}Thanks for getting it back,{NEWLINE}big sister. These are my{CLEAR}favorite snacks. Have some!

strings.zh: 黑暗鸦『Muuu——ro！
strings.en: Murkrow: Muuu-ro!

strings.zh: 向黑暗鸦索要硬币吗？
strings.en: Ask Murkrow for the coin?

strings.zh: 黑暗鸦警觉地看着你。
strings.en: Murkrow eyes you warily.

strings.zh: 黑暗鸦跑走了。
strings.en: Murkrow ran away.

strings.zh: 黑暗鸦似乎被你背包里的金珠{NEWLINE}给吸引住了。{SCROLL}要用金珠跟黑暗鸦交换金币吗？
strings.en: Murkrow seems drawn to{NEWLINE}the Nugget in your Bag.{SCROLL}Trade the Nugget to{NEWLINE}Murkrow for the gold coin?
strings.notes: 金珠 Nugget; the coin is called 硬币 (coin) by the kid and 金币 (gold coin) in the Murkrow menu; kept.

strings.zh: 黑暗鸦很高兴地收下了你的金珠。{NEWLINE}然后……
strings.en: Murkrow happily took{NEWLINE}your Nugget. And then...

strings.zh: 要揍黑暗鸦一顿,{NEWLINE}把金币硬抢过来吗？
strings.en: Beat up Murkrow and take{NEWLINE}the gold coin by force?

strings.zh: 黑暗鸦叼着的金币落在了地上。
strings.en: The gold coin in Murkrow’s{NEWLINE}beak fell to the ground.

strings.zh: 会来收集柑果的训练家,{NEWLINE}一般来说都是四处旅行的强者。{CLEAR}我对你的实力很感兴趣,{CLEAR}你愿意与我来场对战吗？
strings.en: Trainers who come to collect{NEWLINE}Apricorns are usually strong{CLEAR}people who travel all over.{SCROLL}I’m curious how strong you{NEWLINE}are. Will you battle me?

strings.zh: 你希望单打还是双打？
strings.en: Would you like Singles or Doubles?

strings.zh: 单打
strings.en: Singles

strings.zh: 双打
strings.en: Doubles

strings.zh: 先不打了
strings.en: Not now
strings.notes: v3 TM: 3 source(s); other variants: 3 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 全力出击吧,我的精灵！
strings.en: Give it everything, my Pokémon!

strings.zh: 你到底是什么人,怎么会这么强。
strings.en: Who are you, anyway?{NEWLINE}How are you this strong?

strings.zh: 咱们打的是双打,{NEWLINE}你可不能只带1只精灵。
strings.en: We’re having a Double Battle. You{NEWLINE}can’t bring just one Pokémon.

strings.zh: 欧耶！让你看看我新抓精灵的厉害！
strings.en: Oh yeah! Let me show you what{NEWLINE}my newly caught Pokémon can do!

strings.zh: 你好像很厉害,{NEWLINE}还是不打了……
strings.en: You look really strong...{NEWLINE}Maybe I’ll skip the battle...

strings.zh: 麒麟奇『Giii——ra！
strings.en: Girafarig: Giii-ra!

strings.zh: 你仔细观察就会发现,{NEWLINE}麒麟奇的脑袋和尾巴上都有一张脸。{CLEAR}所以有没有可能,{CLEAR}长颈鹿一样的脑袋其实是尾巴,{CLEAR}黑煤球一样的尾巴其实是脑袋。
strings.en: If you look closely, you’ll see Girafarig{NEWLINE}has a face on both its head and its tail.{SCROLL}So isn’t it possible that{NEWLINE}the giraffe-like head is really{CLEAR}the tail, and the lump-of-coal{CLEAR}tail is really the head?

strings.zh: 出门旅行的训练家{NEWLINE}一定不能在买道具时吝啬。{CLEAR}我这里有很多别处没有的好东西,{CLEAR}你看看有没有你需要的。{SCROLL}
strings.en: A traveling Trainer should{NEWLINE}never skimp on buying items.{SCROLL}I’ve got lots of good stuff you{NEWLINE}won’t find anywhere else. See{CLEAR}if there’s anything you need.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 如果还有需要,欢迎再来找我。
strings.en: If you need anything{NEWLINE}else, come find me again.
